Composio.title: Connectors
Composio.apiKeyDescription: Connect your Composio account so Amiro can browse and link your apps. Configured via:
Composio.apiKeyAlternatives: Alternatives: set the COMPOSIO_API_KEY environment variable, or add [composio] api_key to ~/.amiro/amiro.toml. A key saved here overrides both.
Composio.surfaceNote: Connected apps are exposed to the agent through a small search-first tool surface, not hundreds of tools.
Composio.popupBlocked: Please allow popups to complete the connection
Composio.loadError: Couldn't load the app catalogue. Check your API key, then try again.
Composio.noToolkitsDescription: No apps available yet. Check your API key configuration above.
Composio.noConnectedDescription: Connect an app to see it here.
Composio.setupDescription: Connectors are powered by Composio. Add your API key to browse 1000+ apps and let the agent use them.
Composio.setupStep1: Sign in or create a free account at platform.composio.dev.
Composio.setupStep2: Open Settings and copy your API key (it starts with ak_).
Composio.setupStep3: Paste it below and save. Your apps will appear right away.
